verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agents can be created programmatically via the API, SDK and CLI at the organization level. Nothing documents creating an agent run on behalf of, or attributed to, another user. The only user-scoped item is a filter that lists runs initiated by a specific user, which is a read-side feature, not delegated creation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization
